lines.speaker: italy
lines.text: You call that a croissant? It's just butter with confidence.

lines.speaker: france
lines.text: Says the country that argues about pineapple for fun.

lines.speaker: italy
lines.text: Pineapple on pizza is a crime, not a debate!

lines.speaker: france
lines.text: My cheese has more varieties than your excuses.

lines.speaker: italy
lines.text: Then let's settle it. Who makes the better pasta?

lines.speaker: italy
lines.text: Grazie. The crown stays in Rome.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next time: who makes the better coffee?
